task_completion.description: Open the original rocket design file 'dual_parachute_deployment.ork'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket window title or file path shows 'dual_parachute_deployment.ork' being opened.

task_completion.description: Add a 29mm inner diameter motor mount tube (minimum 120mm length) and at least two centering rings inside the existing motor mount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The component tree shows a new Inner Tube (29mm/0.029m diameter) and at least two Centering Rings added as children of the original motor mount.

task_completion.description: Select and load a 29mm motor into the new adapter tube.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Motors and Configuration' tab shows a 29mm motor (e.g., Cesaroni or Aerotech) assigned to the new inner tube.

task_completion.description: Run a flight simulation showing an apogee between 150m and 1,000m and a stable flight.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight Simulations' table shows a green checkmark for stability and an 'Apogee' value between 150 and 1000 meters.
The 'Save As' dialog or the application title bar reflects the filename 'adapted_dual_deploy.ork'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report at '~/Documents/exports/adapter_report.txt' with the required technical details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows a file named 'adapter_report.txt' containing the 29mm ID, motor name, simulated altitude, and confirmation of original mount integrity.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify the rocket design rather than just editing XML or using scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the OpenRocket component tree and configuration dialogs.

integrity.description: The simulation results were actually calculated by the software, not fabricated in the report.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the 'Flight Simulations' tab in OpenRocket match the values written in the final text report.

integrity.description: The original motor mount tube (radius >= 0.018m) was not deleted or resized.
integrity.visual_evidence: The component tree still shows the original motor mount tube with its original dimensions; the new 29mm tube is nested inside it.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The original motor mount radius is 0.018m (18mm). The new adapter must have an inner diameter of 29mm (radius 0.0145m) and a length of at least 120mm. The target apogee range is 150m to 1000m. The final files must be saved as ~/Documents/rockets/adapted_dual_deploy.ork and ~/Documents/exports/adapter_report.txt.
